symptom: The first MCP-Yu atomic write of the full negative-control runner failed with spawn ENAMETOOLONG before the remote file was created.
root_cause: Tool/transport command-size limit for one very large file-write payload, not a defect in the scientific experiment or remote runtime.
repair: Write the exact runner implementation in bounded atomic chunks using a continuation sentinel; do not relax scientific checks to reduce payload size.
reusable_rule: Artifact-generation transport limits are implementation failures. Split large source writes while preserving the designed protocol; never simplify scientific invariants merely to satisfy a tool payload limit.
